description:
Published docs and migration notes for the cutover.

## Content

- Both package READMEs
- Beadwork configuration reference: removed keys, review policy, no landing.validateCommands gate
- Removed tools and `/bw run` behavior (injected prompt)
- Honest: in-process children die with Pi; stuck child may require process exit; shared-checkout conflicts are best effort
- Do not document tmux workers as current

## Success criteria

- An operator who only reads README can run `/bw run EPIC` on tui with minions enabled.
- Removed flags documented as errors, not ignored.

## Test plan

- Grep docs for tmux worker launch as current instructions (should be none, except a "removed" migration section).


## Test plan (expanded)

- README states /bw run injects a prompt, children die with Pi, shared-checkout is advisory.
- Removed flags documented as errors.
- Grep: no current-tense tmux worker instructions outside a Removed/Migration section.
title: Publish cutover README and migration notes
